name: Birla Corporation Ltd
title: Birla Corporation Ltd - 500335 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Capacity held near 21.5 Mtpa until Maihar Line-II (6 Mtpa total to 27.5 by FY29) with ~INR4,300 crore net capex; utilisation near 99% ex-Mukutban, but FY26 EBITDA flagged flat-ish and cash flow weakened on incentive receivables and fuel stock build.

utilisation.quote: close to kind of a 99% utilizatio n is there

capex.peers_comment: Management said some peers announced expansions and are rolling back or slowing capacity; some new UP grinding units are grinding OPC.
capex.quote: I do notice that some people had announced capacity expansion are on a rollback or have announced some rollback or slowdown in their capacity.

triggers.label: Capex ~INR4,300 cr net to 27.5 Mtpa
triggers.quote: INR4,753 crores including GST. Net of GST, it is about INR4,300 crore

triggers.label: Ex-Mukutban utilisation ~99%
triggers.quote: close to kind of a 99% utilizatio n is there

triggers.label: Fuel stock build hits cash flow
triggers.quote: we consciously built up inventory at the year end

guidance.quote: I said mid-single digit in terms of volume.
For FY '27 it is INR900 crores.
we expect the incentives to go up to around INR130 crores
We expect EBITDA to b e similar range to the previous financial year

guidance.metric: Peak net debt this capex cycle
guidance.value: around INR4,000 crores; debt/EBITDA not above 2.5x
guidance.quote: the peak net debt should be in the range of INR4,000 crores

red_flags.label: Operating cash flow fell sharply vs prior year
red_flags.quote: our operating cash flow has kind of declined very sharply versus the previous year

red_flags.label: Net debt rising to ~INR4,000 cr peak
red_flags.quote: the peak net debt should be in the range of INR4,000 crores

red_flags.label: Repeated refusal to give FY27 EBITDA guidance
red_flags.quote: We are not going to give any specific guidance.

evasions.quote: We are not going to give any specific guidance.
But it's difficult to say when we will reach 100 or whether -- what is the level we are today
It's difficult to g ive an estimate on that because most of our term loans are linked to external benchmarks.
